# Fisk's Captains

## Overview
Fisk's five captains command a privateer fleet across the Shattered Sea.
They share a berth, letters of marque, and a common supply route.

## Agenda
The captains seek a secure berth and recruit crews for the next crossing.

## People & Structure
The roster is led by Fisk and five captains.
